experimental_method: Vibrating-tube flow densimeter (Delta rho between pure water and solution) modified to detect phase boundaries: bubble pressures and density differences of NaCl, KCl and CaCl2 solutions near saturation at 623 K (CaCl2 also at 643 K), molalities 0.225-3.234 mol/kg.
uncertainties_stated: vapour pressure +-0.004 p; Delta rho +-(0.0005 + 1e-4 Delta p/MPa) g/cm3; molality +-0.002 m (0.25 mol/kg NaCl +-0.005 m); temperature accuracy 0.15-0.20 K, stability 0.01-0.02 K; pressure transducer calibrated to 0.01 per cent.
quality_remarks: Pure-water check: average of p_a and p_d was 0.002-0.006 p below literature at 633 and 643 K. NaCl 3.000 and 1.000 mol/kg bubble pressures taken from reference 2 (footnote a, also printed on two KCl rows). Printed oddities kept as printed (see mapping notes): rho 0.97349 (CaCl2 3.234, 623.13 K) and 0.56648 (CaCl2 0.225, 642.89 K) inconsistent with neighbouring rows by about 4.5e-4; integer kappa values 20, 18, 1800, 11, 10; Vphi '-243 9'; T 623.090. Scanned PDF, temperature scale not stated. Temperatures in Tables 1 and 2 are mean values per block.
